scope: Proposition 6.4 (Energy for arbitrary injections) of the manuscript “Spontaneous magnetization in the quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet” (preprints/Spontaneous-magnetization-in-the-quantum-Heisenberg-ferromagnet-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8c9083e5eb7a9d6f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let d ≥ 3, α = 1/100, and ν = 1/(100d). Fix M∗ as in (5.13) and take R sufficiently large as in Proposition 6.2. Let T be a finite set of m anchor slots with sites xi, satisfying #{i ∈ T : xi ∈ Bh(z)} ≤ L(1 + h)α for all z ∈ Zd , h ≥ 0. Fix an available-slot graph and a subset I ⊂ T of anchors regular for this graph. For each i ∈ I, let µi be any nonnegative mass on its slots, supported over BR(xi) and satisfying P a µi(a) ≤ 1. There is a flow J such that div J = X i∈I µi, X e J(e)2 ≤ C|I|Rα ≤ CmRα . (6.10) Consequently every finitely supported real function g on the graph satisfies * X i∈I µi, g + ≤ CmRα D(g) 1/2 , D(g) = 1 2 X e (g(e− ) − g(e+ ))2 . (6.11) All constants are uniform over the choices of I and of the masses.
